# Advisories the audit job lets through for now. The CI release job waits for audit, so a new
# advisory in what the app ships stops Preview publishing until the package is moved (in its own
# pull request, per CONTRIBUTING) or an exception is recorded here, in a pull request that gets a
# security read like any change under .github.
#
# One per line:  ID  until=YYYY-MM-DD  reason
#   ID      the advisory: PYSEC-, GHSA-, CVE- (pip-audit) or RUSTSEC- (cargo audit)
#   until   the day it lapses, at most 90 days ahead; after that the audit fails again until
#           someone decides again
#   reason  why it's accepted: not reachable from the app, no fix yet, the fix PR it waits on
#
# Example (not active):
# GHSA-xxxx-xxxx-xxxx  until=2026-11-30  only in the docs build, not shipped; moves in #123
